judged_text: The migration deletes the 'embeddable_hosts' and 'embed_category' site_settings rows while not-yet-restarted app servers in a rolling deploy still run the old code that gates every embed request on SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts, which now falls back to its blank default. On multi-server installs, embed requests 403 intermittently (on each server not yet restarted since the migration ran) even though the new admin UI shows the hosts configured — a silent per-node feature outage during the deploy window.

adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` ends with `execute "DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')"`, and this diff also removes the corresponding settings from `config/site_settings.yml` / `server.en.yml`. While the new runtime code paths (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, `Topic#expandable_first_post?`, `TopicEmbed.import`) no longer consult `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts`/`embed_category`, the diff itself makes it clear that older app servers (still running pre-change code during a rolling deploy) would continue to gate embeds on `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` and could fail once the rows are deleted. This is a real deploy/backward-compatibility concern grounded in the migration, but not a defect in the post-deploy code.
